## Setup

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`.
2. Fill in your own database and cache credentials.
3. Run `npm install` followed by `npm run dev`.

The service listens on port 3000 by default; override it with `PORT`.

## Authentication

Every request must carry your API key in the `Authorization` header as
`Bearer <token>`. Keys are issued from the dashboard under Settings -> API
Keys and can be rotated at any time without downtime.

Requests without a valid key receive a 401 response.
